title: Profile peek redesign
question: Confirm what this coworker profile modal must do so the redesign hits the right shape.

options.label: Quick peek + contact
options.thesis: See who someone is, grab email or phone, optionally open the full profile. Dismiss with X or backdrop.
options.viewport: Compact card: identity, contact, org context, one optional primary action.
options.risk: If overbuilt, it fights the full employee detail page.

options.label: Manager / HR action hub
options.thesis: Admins open this to manage, invite, or jump to full edit. Contact is secondary.
options.viewport: Identity plus strong Manage / Invite actions; denser org context.

options.label: Rich directory card
options.thesis: A fuller mini-profile: bio, reports, manager, location — almost a panel, not a peek.
options.viewport: Taller sheet with bio and hierarchy emphasized.
